title: Qualification Execution Broker durable continuation records

records.rule: Private signing key exists only on the local human workstation; server/MCP/LLM/ed209XX hold public verification material only.
Preflight must prove runnability before intent freeze and before any authorization challenge.
Human signature is over domain-separated SHA-256 of the complete frozen intent; material drift invalidates authorization.
LLM operations are PLAN, REQUEST, AUTHORIZATION.CHALLENGE, AUTHORIZATION.SUBMIT, STATUS, RESULTS and CANCEL; there is no EXECUTE operation.
Only worker authority may transition AUTHORIZED to RUNNING, after pre-execution revalidation.
Worker seals outcome and evidence manifest hash; chat may retrieve status/results later without maintaining an execution session.
